recommendation: Keep the source fix. Let the normal FHIR publication/build regeneration update derived schema, JSON, and diagram artifacts; revisit only if BRR wants to refine the example binding used for coded APD classifications.
issue_request: FHIR-42068 was Applied/Persuasive for BRR. It asked for a place on AdministrableProductDefinition to carry PhPID and similar classifications because PhPID applies to multiple real APDs and is therefore not normally an identifier. The final Jira resolution was to add AdministrableProductDefinition.classification as CodeableReference [0..*] targeting AdministrableProductDefinition, and to update PhPID mapping/examples so real APDs do not put PhPID in identifier.
initial_application: Commit fc82f5ce7ebbb03cf27788dbf277cb3ec50ef547 partially applied the issue by clarifying AdministrableProductDefinition.identifier as an instance identifier, removing the PhPID IDMP mapping from identifier, and adding an APD element. However, it added AdministrableProductDefinition.code as Coding [0..*] rather than the final classification CodeableReference shape, and the active APD example plus the apd-1 invariant test still carried a placeholder PhPID in identifier.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists AdministrableProductDefinition as an active BRR resource, so its StructureDefinition and examples are in current build scope. The originating Zulip thread shows the discussion moving from APD.code to repeatable CodeableReference/classification semantics, including the need to reference parent APDs. BRR minutes on 2024-10-22 record the 15-0-0 vote for FHIR-42068. FHIR-43019 only shared the prior implementation commit and concerns property.value[x] Range, so it was not decided here.
reconciliation: Changed source/administrableproductdefinition/structuredefinition-AdministrableProductDefinition.xml from AdministrableProductDefinition.code/Coding to AdministrableProductDefinition.classification/CodeableReference with targetProfile AdministrableProductDefinition, retained the PhPID IDMP mapping on classification, and updated the active APD example and apd-1 invariant test fixture so the placeholder PhPID is represented as classification.concept rather than identifier.
source_changes: source/administrableproductdefinition/structuredefinition-AdministrableProductDefinition.xml: renamed the partially applied APD code element to classification, changed its type from Coding to CodeableReference, added targetProfile AdministrableProductDefinition, and kept PhPID as the IDMP mapping.
source/administrableproductdefinition/administrableproductdefinition-example.xml: moved the placeholder PhPID from identifier to classification.concept.coding.
source/administrableproductdefinition/invariant-tests/apd-1.f1.fail.xml: made the same PhPID representation change in the invariant test fixture while leaving the apd-1 failure setup intact.

related_jiras.note: Shared the original source commit with FHIR-42068 but concerns AdministrableProductDefinition.property.value[x] Range; it is not decided by this reconciliation.
